wayback._eras_note: Three site generations on one domain: the 2011-2016 WordPress one-pager plus /portfolio (only the home page was crawled by Common Crawl; the Internet Archive holds /portfolio), the 2017-2020 WordPress 'enfold' portfolio (/portfolio/ tiles linking /blog/portfolio/<slug>/, then /portfolio/<slug>/ and /portfolio-item/<slug>/ pages, 2017-2020), and the 2025-2026 Webflow site read live through site_api. The archive eras are parsed by scratch/archive_listings.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with capture_url per row; no era is a wayback-pull.py parser, so this list stays empty and the parsed files are the record.

roster._note: decisions.md D6: the investing people only (the live team page's investment teams and the Management Team, the Form D related persons of 2023, the ADV Schedule A, the archived 2017-2019 team pages); operations, legal, finance, people, communications and portfolio-success staff are left out. Curated in sources/wayback/partner-roster.json.

site_api._entry_stage_note: The live site publishes no round word per company; 'Year Invested' is a close-year anchor (decisions.md D10). The Getro board's stage is refused (standing).
site_api._note: www.speedinvest.com is a Webflow site (2025-): /portfolio is a paginated CMS list of 292 companies (scratch/site_scrape.py -> sources/site/companies-2026.json), /team a 63-person list with team and office tags. careers.speedinvest.com is a Getro board (251 companies; scratch/jobboard-pull.py).

edgar._note: EDGAR 2026-09-30: three Form D filers, all 2023-02-03 at Praterstrasse 1, Vienna: Speedinvest IV EuVECA GmbH & Co KG (CIK 1958034), Speedinvest Opportunity I EuVECA GmbH & Co KG (1958033), Speedinvest Industry & Climate Opportunity EuVECA GmbH & Co KG (1958031). Full-text search on 'Speedinvest' returns those three plus Sea Containers namesake noise (22 hits). Adviser SPEEDINVEST GMBH (CRD 316774, exempt reporting adviser; sources/registers/adv-7b.json).

desks._note: One firm and one adviser (CRD 316774) in Vienna with Berlin, London, Munich, Paris and Abu Dhabi offices (decisions.md D1). Namesakes (Speedinvest SA of Satigny, the French SC/SCI, the Speed Invest companies elsewhere) and the Kalodion feeder are external (D2).

profile._note: One exempt reporting adviser, Speedinvest GmbH (CRD 316774). The site's six sector teams crosswalk to the closed twelve; 'Growth' and 'Middle East, Africa & Beyond' are teams by stage and region, not sectors. focus_min_companies about 4.5% of the ~290-member base.
